_comment: The options the AI decision engine chooses between on Panel E, for the active question.
PLACEHOLDER. Every cost, every lossReduction and the risk appetite must be a figure
you can defend, with a source, before the engine is shown them — the decision is only
as good as these numbers, and they are on screen. The harness computes expected loss
avoided, return on spend and residual 90th percentile from these, so the engine
annualCost is AUD a year. lossReduction is the fraction of annual loss the option
removes (0 to 1). Run `npm run engine -- --check` to see what is still missing.

appetite.note: SET: the 90th-percentile annual loss the reference organisation's board would accept without further action.

accept.description: Accept the risk as it stands. No new spend; keep monitoring.

mitigate.description: Constrain the organisation's AI agents: least-privilege tool scopes, human approval for consequential actions, and prompt-injection testing before release.

transfer.description: Transfer it: a cyber policy with explicit cover for incidents caused by the organisation's own AI systems.

escalate.description: Escalate to the board as a risk-appetite decision before choosing a treatment.
